Name: Old Farmer Brand Public Security
Author: KyleFromPelicanTown
Description:
[b]Description / 描述[/b]
[list]
[*]PublicSecurity adds a detailed, explorable police station to Stardew Valley, complete with a 1F lobby and detention area and a 2F office area. The station can be entered from a custom building in Pelican Town. It also includes an optional electric-fishing crime and pursuit system.[/*]
[*]本模组为《星露谷物语》加入一座可进入的派出所，包含一楼大厅与拘留区域以及二楼办公室区域。派出所在鹈鹕镇拥有独立外观建筑，并提供可选的电鱼犯罪与追捕玩法。[/*]
[/list][b]Installation instructions / 安装说明[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI first, then unzip the downloaded mod and place the entire PublicSecurity
 folder inside the game's Mods folder. Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI.[/*]
[*]先安装 SMAPI，然后解压下载的 Mod，并将整个 PublicSecurity 文件夹放入游戏的 Mods 文件夹。之后使用 SMAPI 启动《星露谷物语》。[/*]
[/list][b]Main features / 主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds custom 1F and 2F police station maps with furniture, lighting, windows, stairs, seating, and an accessible detention room.[/*]
[*]Adds a custom exterior building with a vanilla-style door interaction and map travel.[/*]
[*]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45923]Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine[/url] installed, using an electric fishing machine in valid locations adds criminal heat. Lewis, Linus, and Kent can pursue and arrest the player.[/*]
[*]Arrested players are taken to the detention room, lose their electric fishing machine, and can confirm sleep to spend the night. Releasing sends the player back to the Forest the next morning.[/*]
[*]新增自定义一层与二层派出所地图，包含家具、照明、窗户、楼梯、座椅和拘留室。[/*]
[*]新增自制派出所外观建筑，采用原版风格门格交互，可进入一楼并通过楼梯前往二楼。[/*]
[*]安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45923]老农民牌电鱼机（Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine）[/url] 后，在水边使用电鱼机会逐渐累积犯罪值；刘易斯、莱纳斯与肯特会依据星级追捕并拘留玩家。[/*]
[*]被抓后玩家会进入拘留室并被没收电鱼机，可确认睡觉后过夜，次日获释并传送至森林。[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements / 环境要求[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. SMAPI 4.1.0+ should also work.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45923]Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine[/url] is optional and enables the electric-fishing pursuit and detention features.[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 或更高版本，4.1.0+理论兼容。[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45923]老农民牌电鱼机（Old Farmer Brand Electric Fish Machine）[/url] 为可选依赖；安装后可启用电鱼追捕与拘留功能。[/*]
[/list][b]Shout outs / 特别感谢[/b]
[list]
[*]小红书账号：鹈鹕镇的小凯、皮蛋酥球[/*]
[*]抖音账号：鹈鹕镇的小凯、皮蛋酥球[/*]
[*]哔哩哔哩账号：鹈鹕镇的小凯[/*]
[/list]
